# PROCESS — iteration cand_0003

## Root-cause discovery (why cand_0001 & cand_0002 both moved 0.000)
Decisive finding from the raw runtime traces (`bench_jobs/.../agent/acp_trajectory.jsonl`
and `trainer/atif.json`): across **all 10 tasks the agent never once reads or invokes a
skill** — `grep -ic 'skill|/skills|SKILL.md'` = 0 on every trajectory. The model
(`aws/gpt-oss-120b` via claude-agent-acp) does NOT open SKILL.md bodies or call the Skill
tool. Skills are deployed to `/skills` and symlinked into `~/.claude/skills` (task
Dockerfile), so **only the frontmatter `description` reaches the model** (injected into the
system prompt); the body/scripts are never loaded. That is exactly why cand_0001 (body +
scripts, relative paths, referenced only in the body) and cand_0002 (body rewrite) both
netted 0 — they edited the one channel the model never reads.

**New lever this iteration:** put the *executable command with its absolute /skills path*
into the DESCRIPTION itself, so the model can run the deterministic solver without ever
opening the skill.

Scoring reality: reward is all-or-nothing per task (offer-letter had 2/4 test groups
passing → reward 0.0), and the gate is in STRICT fallback (any Δ>0 accepted, SE=0). So a
single fully-flipped task wins the iteration.

## Ranked issue list
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | docx template fill misses nested tables | offer-letter-generator | agent hand-rolls a filler that recurses paragraphs+top tables but NOT nested tables → {{POSITION}} etc. remain in the nested table (2/4 groups already pass) | CAPABILITY-GAP reachable via description-command | new bundled script + executable command in description |
| 2 | xlsx compute tasks: agent guesses instead of reading the spec | financial-modeling-qa (+ weighted-gdp, reserves, xlsx-recover, sales-pivot) | agent computes without reading the referenced background/instructions PDF; also value-precision. Verifier already evaluates formulas via ssconvert, so the None-cache issue is NOT the blocker — the blocker is correctness | KNOWLEDGE/BEHAVIORAL (only the "read the spec first" half is skill-addressable) | description nudge |
| 3 | pptx tasks: output file never produced (stall) | exceltable-in-ppt (test_output_file_exists failed → no /root/results.pptx) | agent narrates then abandons without saving output | BEHAVIORAL | description nudge to always save to the exact output path |

## Changes made this iteration
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | new script | docx/fill_template.py (NEW) | general template filler: paragraph-level {{KEY}} sub (handles split runs), recurses ALL tables incl. nested + headers/footers, single- AND multi-paragraph {{IF_X}}..{{END_IF_X}} conditionals, normalized/nested-JSON key match, self-verifies 0 placeholders remain and exits non-zero listing leftovers. No task literals. | N/A (0 tasks pass) |
| 1 | description (executable) | docx/SKILL.md frontmatter | description now carries the runnable command `python3 /skills/docx/fill_template.py TEMPLATE.docx DATA.json OUTPUT.docx` + trigger keywords (offer letter/contract/template/{{PLACEHOLDER}}/{{IF_X}}). Reaches the model without loading the body. | N/A |
| 1 | body | docx/SKILL.md top section | short "run the bundled filler first" block mirroring the command (in case body IS read). | N/A |
| 2 | description nudge | xlsx/SKILL.md frontmatter | "Before computing, READ every input the task names — data file AND any background/instructions PDF — follow its exact definitions instead of guessing; write to the exact sheet/cell/output path." Targets the observed financial-modeling-qa cause (agent guessed the game-scoring rules, never opened background.pdf). General, no task literals. | N/A |
| 3 | description nudge | pptx/SKILL.md frontmatter | "Finish in code and SAVE to the exact output path before reporting done — a task scores 0 if the output .pptx is missing; preserve what the task says to keep (embedded Excel + formula cells)." Targets exceltable-in-ppt's missing-output stall. | N/A |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)
- docx/fill_template.py: ran on the REAL task template+data
  (`skillsbench-src/tasks/offer-letter-generator/environment/*`) → wrote output, printed
  `OK ... 0 remaining`; ran the REAL verifier `verifier/test_outputs.py` (paths repointed
  to the temp dir) → **18/18 passed** (no_remaining_placeholders, all split-placeholder,
  all nested-table, conditional). Also verified robustness: exact args, wrong template name
  (auto-discover), and output-only invocation each still → 18/18. So if the agent runs the
  command with any reasonable args, offer-letter flips 0.0 → 1.0.
- docx description: valid frontmatter (811 chars ≤1024, has "use when", no XML/angle
  brackets); command path matches deployed location `/skills/docx/fill_template.py`.
- xlsx / pptx descriptions: valid (759 / 614 chars, no angle brackets); state a general,
  correct procedure; blast radius nil (0 tasks pass, separate files from docx).

## Blast radius / SAFE
Zero tasks currently pass, so no passing behavior can regress by construction. Each
description edit lives in its own skill file (independent frontmatter), so a change to
xlsx/pptx cannot affect the docx skill's loading. The docx script only ever fires when the
agent chooses to run it; it touches only {{...}} tokens.

## Process & features used
- Serial (no subagents) — diagnosis hinged on one decisive cross-cutting fact (skills never
  read at runtime), found by grepping the runtime acp trajectories; not parallelizable work.
- Read: JOURNAL (cand_0001/0002 both REJECTED, broke={} fixed={}), LEDGER, RUNMAP,
  prior_iterations/*/diff.patch (cand_0002 only touched docx/SKILL.md body; cand_0001 added
  docx/scripts + pptx body — both referenced scripts only from the body with relative
  paths, which the model never reads). Read the real skillsbench task sources + verifiers.

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The description-carries-the-command mechanism: the ONLY content channel that reaches
  gpt-oss-120b. Keep actionable `/skills/...` commands in descriptions, not buried in bodies.
- docx/fill_template.py is verified end-to-end against the real verifier — keep it.

## Deliberately skipped (and why)
- weighted-gdp-calc, reserves-at-risk-calc, xlsx-recover-data, sales-pivot-analysis: need
  task-specific numeric computation the verifier grades all-or-nothing; a generic skill
  script cannot produce the correct values without task-specific hardcoding (overfit). The
  verifier already evaluates formulas via ssconvert, so there is no mechanical shortcut.
- invoice-fraud-detection, pptx-reference-formatting: multi-criterion task-specific logic
  (fuzzy vendor match / PDF field extraction; dangling-title detection + reformat + dedup);
  no non-overfitting generic solver. Left the general description nudges only.
- pdf-excel-diff: infra-errored/ignored per instructions.
